source: synthetic weather fixture, not live data
note: SYNTHETIC COMPETITION DEMO FIXTURE -- not Open-Meteo historical data and not a real forecast. Hand-authored TrailGuard replay asset (spec 17, 24) used to demonstrate the Phase 2 route-aware weather chain: the same projected position asked about at four different horizons meets a discrete hourly grid whose hazard worsens later in the day, so the ONLY thing that changes between NOW and +120 min is the weather at the projected position and projected arrival time. Values are invented. Stored in Open-Meteo's response shape (parallel 'hourly' arrays, 'hourly_units', 'utc_offset_seconds') so the same normalisation layer that parses a live response parses this file; precipitation_probability is in percent ('%' in hourly_units, exactly as Open-Meteo reports it) and is divided by 100 to obtain the 0..1 probability the TrailGuard schemas use.
